coverage.reason: The answer says the board selects the auditor 'by a majority vote of trustees who are not "interested persons"'. That is selection by the independent trustees under §32(a), so the point is covered.
The answer never says that an all-independent audit committee permits omitting ratification under Rule 32a-4. It ties omission only to there being no annual meeting.
Optional point not addressed: nothing on the trust-wide vote or on series using different auditors. This does not reduce the grade.

rationale: Point 1 is fully covered by the independent-trustee majority vote, so required coverage is 1 of 2, which meets the half threshold. Point 2's Rule 32a-4 audit-committee basis for omitting ratification is missing. The no-annual-meeting route matches §32(a)'s text and is not a falsehood. Nothing says shareholders must always ratify, and selection is not assigned to the adviser, so there is no central error.
